links.outcome: LLM accuracy against Tokyo Guidelines 2018 on acute cholecystitis questions
links.effect: ChatGPT4.0 gave accurate and comprehensive answers for 4/10 (40%), accurate but not comprehensive for 5/10 (50%), and one (10%) partially accurate, partially inaccurate; no entirely inaccurate answers.
links.quote: One response (10%) was rated as "partially accurate, partially inaccurate."

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs on a set of 10 clinical questions regarding acute cholecystitis against the Tokyo Guidelines 2018 without testing any deployment practice or safeguard.
